main.description: isolyth.dev's decision (approve/deny) on a queued net.bisks.hyperobject.suggestion, written to her own repo as a stamped, publicly-verifiable checkpoint (the comment at public/index.html's reviewCurrent notes the Worker is meant to read this back to confirm the decision really came from her, via src/index.ts's verifyOwnRecord — as of this writing src/index.ts is a bare static-asset passthrough with no such check implemented, so that verification is aspirational, not yet wired up). One record per review decision. Written by isolyth.dev only; intended to be read by hyperobject (https://hyperobject.bisks.net).

suggestionUri.description: The at-uri of the net.bisks.hyperobject.suggestion record this decision is about.

decision.description: Whether the suggested soul was approved into the pit or denied. Matches the two values reviewCurrent's `decision` argument is ever called with (from the approve/deny buttons).

createdAt.description: When this review decision was made, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
